The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Bill 185 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Ehrhart of the following substitute to HB 185: 36th and Powell of the 33rd
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to professions and businesses, so as to repeal and reenact Chapter 11A, the "Dietetics Practice Act"; to provide for … 1503 This Act shall become effective upon its approval by the Governor or upon its becoming law 1504 without such approval.
1505 SECTION 3-2. 1506 All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
